messages:
maria: uploaded a compact mock for the trace drilldown header. two quick dilemmas: should the download affordance be an icon by the kebab or only inside the menu? and what's the best short helper under the truncated correlation id? figma: https://figma.com/s/compact-trace-drilldown

*tariq:* my vote is icon+menu redundancy. support needs fast access without hunting. make the icon non-primary and ensure a clear aria-label.

*sam:* agree on redundancy but prefer the tab order: CID -> more -> download, so copying the id remains the primary flow. also keyboard users need the icon reachable without adding extra tabindex noise.

*katie:* copy: under CID, use "Click to copy full correlation ID". for the download tooltip, "Download trace and attachments (zip)" reads well.

*eli:* a11y: use a native button for the icon, `aria-label="Download trace and attachments"`, and add an `aria-live` toast for when download starts. ensure focus stays predictable.

*maria:* plan proposal: small download icon left of kebab + export in kebab; helper: "Click to copy full correlation ID"; tab order CID -> more -> download; button has visible focus ring and `aria-label`. I'll update the figma.

*design-bot:* checklist: keyboard order, aria-label on icon, visible focus styles, contrast check for helper text. missing: SR announcement text for download start.

*maria:* noted. i'll add SR text "Starting download for trace <id>" to the prototype. can someone run VoiceOver/NVDA once i push?

*katie:* i'll do VoiceOver and post notes.

*sam:* i'll run NVDA and test keyboard flow.

*tariq:* i'll add the exact aria attr draft to the PR.

*design-bot:* thread will be archived in 7 days if no activity.
